recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑旁的造血組織被片狀大型組織球取代，細胞質豐富淡染、呈細纖維或泡沫空泡狀，核小而居中或偏位；右上角可見被擠壓的殘存造血細胞與淋巴球，符合儲積症巨噬細胞浸潤。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, fibrillary to vacuolated cytoplasm replacing marrow
Small round bland nuclei with low N:C ratio; some cells with foamy vacuoles
Focal pink granular extracellular material/hemorrhage within the infiltrate
Residual hematopoietic cells and lymphocytes concentrated at one edge (upper right)
Adjacent bony trabeculae without osteoblastic rimming; no atypia or mitoses
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale fibrillary to foamy cytoplasm and small bland nuclei replacing the marrow adjacent to bony trabeculae. Residual hematopoietic cells and small lymphocytes are compressed at the periphery, and focal extravasated red cells are present within the infiltrate. No granulomas, necrosis or cytologic atypia are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by storage cell macrophages of a lysosomal storage disorder.

ddx.vs: They are admixed with a clonal neoplasm such as CML or myeloma rather than forming a pure histiocytic infiltrate, with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic crystalline immunoglobulin and associate with a light-chain-restricted plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm.
Granulomas are discrete nodules of epithelioid cells with lymphocytic cuffs, unlike diffuse sheets of voluminous pale storage cells.
